text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the season for summer camp, but as
we kick
into full gear in preparation for
the fall G1
races...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Geez, there's no helpin' that dummy. But
of all
the things to fight over...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. Turns out my li'l bro got
into a scrap
with some local squirt.

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Boy
text_block_list.text:
Heh, Oguri Cap's da best! Her runnin's
somethin'
else! Oguri Cap's gonna
dominate her whole
generation.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Little Brother
text_block_list.text:
Nuh-uh! My big sis Tama's da toughest
of 'em all!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The way Oguri ran has got everyone real
hyped
up. Well... I guess I can kinda see
why.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She looked real flashy out there.
'Specially in the
last stretch, when she
was fightin' for first...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri's style always makes for a thrilling
finish. It
gets so close, no one can tell
who's gonna come
out on top.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, however intense things get, a win's
a win. If
it were me, I'd rather be first
than flashy, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So how does Oguri keep pullin' stunts
like that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross can't seem to take her
mind off
Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In situations like these, there's only one
thing to
do.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You want me to go ask Oguri? Here?
choice_data_list: 聞いてみたら？この夏合宿で
choice_data_list_en: Why not ask during this summer camp?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Ya got a point. Y'know, I've been
wonderin'
what she thinks about when
she's runnin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I just never got a good opening to ask,
y'know?
It'd be embarrassing to pester
about it in our
room. Haha...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We won't be racin' against each other
this fall.
She's still in her classic year.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But we're gonna be runnin' together at
some
point, so it'd prob'ly be good to
ask what kinda
emotions she's dealin'
with, y'know?, Before we're
competin'!
